structural_fix_ruling.decision: COMMISSION — design a commit-mutex / advisory-lock that keeps everything on main
structural_fix_ruling.rejection_reason: worktrees require branches; violates HARD user constraint 'NO branches, all work on main' (CLAUDE.md + every pilot constraints_binding_day_0). No justification clears the absolute no-branches rule.
structural_fix_ruling.why_commit_mutex: Lower-risk AND the only option preserving no-branches. Narrows serialization from the whole worker (interim) down to JUST the commit window (stage->commit->verify), recovering overlapped build/test throughput. Additive lock around existing stage/commit step; no history rewrite; coexists with WAIT guard; git reset HEAD foreign paths stays forbidden inside the lock.
structural_fix_ruling.throughput_rationale: Decisions 1-3 make 2 concurrent pilots the steady state. Interim policy serializes the entire (minutes-long) worker; commit-mutex serializes only the (seconds-long) commit window, letting the long build/test phases of both pilots parallelize.
